remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. At Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "On backing: In pencil by O'Keeffe 'Red Canna' Georgia O'Keeffe. 1919 [not verified, inscription probably by Stieglitz]. Also, by OK, OK in circle [not verified]. Orange canna with dark purple leaf." Verso inscription 3 dates 1919 and indicates no. 109 in the 1923 New York (Anderson) exhibition. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: Alfred Stieglitz 'Red Canna 1919'" [not verified]. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 19, 20. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: verso inscription 1, Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Red Canna

description: A reddish orange canna with a glowing yellow center stands in the middle of the canvas. The canna is attached to a pink stem, with pink buds surrounding it. Cloudlike forms in green and blue fill the background.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
